name: Register a vehicle
title: Register a vehicle
description:
Create a reusable vehicle identity with a clear display name, vehicle type, and a stable registration/identifier only where collection and retention are authorized. Status should reflect the record's operational state. Vehicle images are optional and should have an approved source.

Do not create a duplicate vehicle for every detection. A Motion Event can remain unlinked when the vehicle cannot be identified; use uncertainty rather than a speculative identity. Reopen the vehicle and verify its type and identifier before linking events.
